settings.text: Find quick answers about orders, shipping, payments, returns, and more. Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to our team any time.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking link.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Contact us within 2 hours of placing your order and we'll do our best to update it before it ships.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive within 3-5 business days. Expedited options are available at checkout.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to select international destinations. Rates and timelines are calculated at checkout.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit cards as well as popular digital wallets at checkout.

settings.question: Is it safe to enter my card details?
settings.answer: Yes, all transactions are encrypted and processed through a secure, PCI-compliant checkout.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unopened products can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Reach out to our support team with your order number and we'll send over the next steps.

settings.question: Are your products cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes, every Bloom Beauty product is cruelty-free and never tested on animals.

settings.question: Where are your products made?
settings.answer: Our formulas are developed and manufactured in small batches to ensure consistent quality.
